campaign.title: Unbalanced reciprocal-frequency signed-Gram and near-product factorization gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use no external theorem unless its primary statement matches the literal truncated chi_4 row, moving sampled profiles, real-to-integer centre perturbation, signed near-reciprocal aliases, pointwise norm, and required power. Do not import a complete divisor or circle estimate.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact flat-smooth UNBAL wave be phase-integerized at target-safe cost and then bounded through a character-preserving joint frequency Gram whose reciprocal aliases factor around N^2, or does the construction rigorously self-return?
frozen_target.reference_formula: R_X=sum_(r odd)chi_4(r)W(X/(rD))sum_k q_L(4Xk/r^2)k^(-1)e(Xk/r), with D=X^delta, L=X^ell, R=X/D, K=XL/D^2, and target R_X<<X^(1/4+epsilon).
quantities: X real at least 2 and N=floor X
literal fixed q_L and W profiles, including support overlap and edges
phase-only integerized row with amplitudes still frozen at X
physical product kernels centred at X and N with denominator 4X
weighted k-Cauchy Gram and its full signed ordered-pair expansion
diagonal r=s and every off-diagonal reciprocal alias
N=2^tN_0, exact and near collisions, negative and zero aliases, and mod-four character signs
flat-smooth owner only; every hard, sharp, starred, clipped, arithmetic, and transition owner excluded

completion_criteria: Prove or reject uniform phase integerization without a circular post-cancellation charge.
Derive the exact smallest weighted Gram with literal sampled amplitudes and quantify its diagonal.
Prove uniform reciprocal-frequency localization with support-overlap and endpoint costs.
Factor every alias collision and derive the correct defect window and factor congruences.
Audit all two-adic, mod-four, sign, zero-alias, negative-alias, and tie branches.
Keep the signed off-diagonal intact; distinguish exact-collision divisor counts from the full near window.
Determine whether defect parity yields a noninvertible gain or only restates the original quarter shift.
Prove the full target, a strict target-safe subrange, a quantified signed saving or inverse theorem, or a rigorous smallest-survivor no-go.
State exactly what follows for flat smooth UNBAL, complete UNBAL, M9-M2, M9, the quarter target, and every exponent.

tasks.target: Independently prove or refute phase integerization, derive the literal weighted Gram and every alias-product/parity branch, and obtain a target, saving, inverse theorem, or smallest no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-107 through Round-123 nonblind artifacts
required_output: A complete phase-perturbation, Gram, alias, and parity derivation.
A target estimate, strict signed gain, inverse theorem, or explicit smallest no-go.
A promote, retain, revise, reject, or no-change recommendation.

tasks.target: Attack the complete signed Gram in factor coordinates, seeking defect-parity cancellation, a target-safe alias sector, a strict exponent gain, or a quantified inverse theorem.
required_output: Exact factor-coordinate formulas, congruences, capacities, and character signs.
A target, strict signed gain, inverse theorem, or smallest exact survivor.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit the perturbation norm, Gram target equivalence, diagonal cancellation burden, factor and character algebra, alias windows, endpoint scope, circularity, and duplication of prior transforms.
required_output: A pass/fail seam table with normalization, parity, capacity, and scope controls.
The maximal safe theorem or fatal correction and exact smallest survivor.

review_seams.requirement: The real-to-integer phase change is proved with the physical product kernel and uniform tails, not charged termwise against a capacity obtained only after oscillation.
The Cauchy weight, target square, literal profile overlap, ordered-pair expansion, reality, and diagonal size are exact.
Every reciprocal alias has the correct orientation, nearest-integer convention, defect scale, factor congruence, and zero/negative branch.
The two-adic and mod-four sign formula is valid for exact and near defects without silently assuming N odd or j even.
A claimed saving controls the complete signed diagonal plus off-diagonal; exact collisions and absolute counts are not substituted for the near window.
The factor coordinates or a second transform are not called a gain if they reconstruct the Round-118 sparse selector or scalar quarter-shift estimate.
A flat-smooth result is not promoted to hard or transition kernels, complete UNBAL, M9-M2, M9, or an exponent without every graph bridge.
